title: [Master]-Missing VAT Identifier in Peppol XML for Zero-Value Invoice
summary: The PEPPOL XML generation now includes the VAT identifier even for invoices with zero values, fixing a compliance issue with Peppol standards.
key_points: VAT Identifier is now included in PEPPOL XML output for zero-value invoices
Modifications made to the PEPPOL30 implementation codeunit
New test cases added to verify VAT identifier presence in billing documents
Addresses a missing field in XML generation that is required by Peppol specifications
